How do I use it correctly to get the best result?
To get the best performance and longest life out of your Vertical Spice rack, here are a few simple tips for setup and everyday use:
1. Mount It Securely: Always attach the base to your cabinet bottom or a fixed shelf using all the included self-tapping screws. Securing the base prevents the unit from tipping forward when heavy drawers are fully extended.
2. Check Shelf Clearance: If installing on a movable/adjustable shelf, make sure to secure or lock the shelf itself so it doesn't bow or lift when you pull out a loaded drawer.
